pcDirPath: The folder to hold, as a path; a missing folder is created, and an empty text means the current process folder.
_cFolderPath_: The folder to examine, as a path.
cParentFolder: The candidate parent folder, as a name relative to this folder's path.
_cName_: A file or folder name, as text; any slash form and any case is accepted.
acPaths: A list of paths, as text.
acFilesNames: A list of file names, as text.
nCurrentLevel: The depth of the folder being counted, 1 for the first level.
nMaxLevel: The deepest level to count; deeper levels add 0.
acFoldersNames: A list of folder names, as text.
b: 1 to turn batch mode on, 0 to turn it off.
paNames: A list of folder names, as text.
_cFolder_: A folder, as a name or a path.
_cFile_: A file, as a name or a path.
acFileNames: A list of file names to create.
pPattern: A file name, a pattern with * as a wildcard, or a list of file names.
_cPattern_: A name, or a pattern with * as a wildcard, as text.
_cExt_: A file extension, with or without the leading dot.
cContent: The text to look for, as text.
_acFiles_: A list of file names, as text.
_acFolders_: A list of folder names, as text.
cOrder: A display order: systemorder, filefirstascending, filefirstdescending, folderfirstascending or folderfirstdescending, in any case.
aFoldersWithMatches: The list that receives the folders found.
oFolder: The stzFolder whose counts are read.
_cStatPattern_: A statistics pattern built from the keywords @count, @countfiles, @countfolders, @deepcountfiles and @deepcountfolders.
_bSubfolderHasMatches_: 1 if the subfolder holds a match.
_bShouldExpand_: 1 if the folder is shown open.
_cPrefix_: The text put before each line of the tree, to indent it.
bIsRoot: 1 when the tree starts at the top folder.
cSearchType: What the matches mark: files, folders, both, or showxt for the statistics view.
nMaxLevels: The depth at which the tree stops.
